data.body: Gerrit change 1777 (Change-Id Ic137695305c9fb66387f83155596e40b8c7530dc): LLM-Review +1 (PASS) with one NON-BLOCKING advisory (already marked resolved, does not block submit). Advisory: the code-macro assertion uses a literal {code} block, which the codec passes through _EXACT in both rich modes, so that single assertion proves faithful pass-through + live Jira {code}->\<pre\> rendering rather than a codec CONVERSION. That is inherent and intentional: wiki_render deliberately LOCKS all code (fenced/indented/{code}) verbatim so code fragments survive byte-for-byte, so NO Markdown construct converts into a {code} macro — the only wire that yields a rendered code panel is a real {code} block. The heading (# -> h1. -> \<h1\>) and bold (** -> * -> \<b\>) assertions DO exercise the codec's Markdown->wiki conversion, so the test as a whole exercises the cutover codec. The _rich_markdown docstring documents this rationale. No code change made. Awaiting Verified +1, then Submit.
